answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an umber bet on surviving 114 epochs of grading, and every jetty settlement recomputes the willow schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 114 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
